validation_notes: All original 100 Petrobangla rows and 10 GTCL check rows remain unchanged.
All 2,379 available Petrobangla PDFs were parsed; 11 conflicting reporting dates are excluded from new data.
Four nine-page Petrobangla PDFs were inspected: later pages are supporting sheets for the same reporting periods, not additional days.
Three incomplete headings use explicit embedded workbook month/year titles with matching PDF creation dates; per-report evidence is retained.
All 312 image-only GTCL failures were tried with OCR at 120 and 220 dpi. 82 passed unique nine-component production reconciliation; 230 remain rejected.
OCR is used only for national GTCL production/LNG comparisons; no power-sector value is inferred from scans.
Missing calendar dates and unreadable reports are not interpolated.
